description: Angular component for managing a panel of data keys in a widget configuration, including form handling, validation, drag-and-drop reordering, and dynamic data key management.

classes.name: DataKeysPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring and managing data keys within a widget, supporting validation, drag-and-drop, and dynamic form updates.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscription.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, updating parameters accordingly.

methods.name: updateParams
methods.description: Sets the dataKeyType based on datasourceType and widgetType.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for propagating value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form group.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the form control value with provided data keys.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form and sets error messages.

methods.name: keysFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array of keys.

methods.name: trackByKey
methods.description: Tracks form controls for rendering optimization.

methods.name: removeKey
methods.description: Removes a key at specified index.

methods.name: addKey
methods.description: Adds a new data key to the form array.

methods.name: prepareKeysFormArray
methods.description: Prepares a form array from a list of data keys.
